answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by requiring each agent to submit a succinct non-interactive zero-knowledge proof that its state transition satisfies a formally verified invariant, binding identity to a unique stake-weighted delta recorded on-chain. Colluding agents that attempt to register duplicate identities from the same dune of stake trigger a whisper protocol of. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
